sections.title: Signing in
sections.summary: Create your login with the email address you were invited at, confirm it, then sign in from any phone or computer.

shots.caption: Signing in
shots.alt: RAMP sign-in screen on a phone with Sign in selected, email and password fields, the Sign in button and the Forgot your password link.

hotspots.label: Sign in or New here
hotspots.text: Pick **New here** the first time you use RAMP. After that, stay on **Sign in**.

hotspots.label: Email
hotspots.text: Use the address your invitation went to. RAMP matches your login to your invite by email.

hotspots.label: Password
hotspots.text: Tap the eye to check what you typed.

hotspots.label: Sign in
hotspots.text: Opens your Home screen, or the welcome flow if you haven’t finished setup.

hotspots.label: Forgot your password?
hotspots.text: Sends a link to choose a new password.

shots.caption: Creating your login with New here
shots.alt: The New here tab on a phone: Create your login, with the invited email filled in, a password and the Create login button.

hotspots.label: New here
hotspots.text: The tab for creating your login. Your invite link may open it for you.

hotspots.label: Invited email
hotspots.text: Type the exact email HR invited. A different address won’t match your invite.

hotspots.label: New password
hotspots.text: At least 8 characters. Use one you don’t use anywhere else.

hotspots.label: Create login
hotspots.text: We email you a confirmation link. Open it on the same device to finish.

steps.title: Get your invite
steps.text: HR adds you to RAMP and sends you a message with a link. Open it on your phone or computer.

steps.title: Create your login
steps.text: Tap **New here**, type the exact email your invite went to, choose a password of at least 8 characters and tap **Create login**.

steps.title: Confirm your email
steps.text: Open the confirmation link we email you, on the same device. RAMP then opens your welcome flow.

steps.title: Sign in next time
steps.text: Stay on **Sign in**, enter your email and password, and tap **Sign in**. You land on Home.

steps.title: Reset a forgotten password
steps.text: Tap **Forgot your password?**, enter your email and tap **Send reset link**. Follow the link, choose a new password and tap **Save and continue**.

tips: No email after a minute? Check spam or promotions.
If RAMP says you’re not on the team list, your email doesn’t match an invite. Sign out and use the invited address, or tap **Request access**.
Guest access is time-limited. When it ends, ask your contact at the company to extend it.

sections.title: Finding your way around
sections.summary: On a computer the menu runs down the left side. On a phone it’s a bar along the bottom, with everything else under More.

shots.caption: On a computer: the sidebar
shots.alt: RAMP Home on a computer, signed in as an admin. The left sidebar lists Home, Training, Tasks, Notebook, Chat, Resources, News, Team progress, Guide and the Admin portal, with the profile and sign-out button at the bottom.

hotspots.label: Main menu
hotspots.text: Every page you use day to day. The highlighted item is where you are.

hotspots.label: Badges
hotspots.text: Amber numbers count news you still need to confirm and work waiting for your review.

hotspots.label: Guide
hotspots.text: Opens this guide, filtered to what you can do.

hotspots.label: Admin portal
hotspots.text: Owners and admins only. Opens setup, people, metrics and system pages.

hotspots.label: Your profile
hotspots.text: Your details, documents, sign-in history and password.

hotspots.label: Sign out
hotspots.text: Signs you out on this device.

shots.caption: On a phone: the bottom bar and More
shots.alt: The More page on a phone, with the bottom bar showing Home, Training, Tasks, Chat and More. More lists the profile, Notebook, Resources, News, Guide, Vault, Replay the platform tour and Sign out.

hotspots.label: Profile and documents
hotspots.text: Your details, documents and sign-in history.

hotspots.label: Other pages
hotspots.text: Notebook, Resources, News, this Guide and your Vault.

hotspots.label: Replay the platform tour
hotspots.text: Run the practice sandbox again any time.

hotspots.label: Sign out
hotspots.text: Signs you out on this phone.

hotspots.label: Bottom bar
hotspots.text: Home, Training, Tasks and Chat are always one tap away.

hotspots.label: More
hotspots.text: Everything else. An amber dot means unread news or work to review.

steps.title: Open a page
steps.text: Click an item in the sidebar, or tap one in the bottom bar on a phone. The highlighted item shows where you are.

steps.title: Find everything else on a phone
steps.text: Tap **More** for Notebook, Resources, News, the Guide, your Vault and the practice tour.

steps.title: Check your badges
steps.text: An amber number next to **News**, **My team** or **Team progress** means something is waiting. On a phone, look for the dot on **More**.

steps.title: Open your profile
steps.text: Click your name at the bottom of the sidebar, or your initials at the top right on a phone.

steps.title: Sign out
steps.text: Click the arrow next to your name, or tap **Sign out** at the bottom of More.

tips: What you see depends on your access level. Mentors and leads get **My team**; admins get **Team progress** and the **Admin portal**.
If an owner switches off Chat or Tasks, it leaves the menu for everyone.
Guests see Home, Training, Resources, Guide and Profile.

sections.title: Your welcome flow
sections.summary: The first time you sign in, RAMP walks you through a few setup steps before your training starts. You can stop and pick up where you left off.

shots.caption: The documents step of the welcome flow
shots.alt: The welcome flow on a phone at step 4 of 6, Documents. Two documents are done and two are still to do, with Fill out and Review and sign buttons, and a disabled Continue button showing 2 left.

hotspots.label: Sign out
hotspots.text: Stop for now. Next time you sign in, you pick up at this step.

hotspots.label: Steps
hotspots.text: One bar per step. Amber is where you are. Tap a finished step to go back to it.

hotspots.label: Done
hotspots.text: Tap **View** to see what you sent, or **Submit again** to update it.

hotspots.label: Still to do
hotspots.text: Tap **Fill out**, **Upload** or **Review and sign** to complete it.

hotspots.label: Continue
hotspots.text: Unlocks once every document is in. The counter says how many are left.

steps.title: Read the welcome
steps.text: Read the message from the team and check your role, department and mentor. Tap **Let’s get started**.

steps.title: Set up your profile
steps.text: Confirm your full name, add a preferred name, phone number and time zone, then tap **Save and continue**.

steps.title: Practice the platform
steps.text: Tap **Start practice** for the five-minute sandbox, or **Do it later** to skip it for now.

steps.title: Complete your documents
steps.text: Tap **Fill out**, **Upload** or **Review and sign** on each one. **Continue** unlocks when they’re all done.

steps.title: Meet your mentor
steps.text: See who your mentor is and what they help with, then tap **Continue**.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Tap **Go to my dashboard**, or **Message my mentor** to say hello. First-week documents are added to your tasks.

tips: Your admin chooses which steps you see, so yours may have fewer.
Tap a finished bar at the top to go back to that step.
**Sign out** keeps your place. Next time you sign in, you continue from the same step.

sections.title: Practising in the sandbox
sections.summary: A five-minute practice copy of RAMP with nine quick missions. Nothing you do there is saved.

shots.caption: A practice mission
shots.alt: The practice sandbox on a phone. A dark mission card reads Mission 3 of 9, Create a task, and a glowing amber outline marks the New task button in the sample task board.

hotspots.label: Exit
hotspots.text: Leave whenever you like. Platform basics stays in Training until you finish.

hotspots.label: Mission
hotspots.text: What to do next, with a hint. The bars show how many missions you’ve done.

hotspots.label: Practice copy
hotspots.text: Sample content only. Tap around freely: nothing here touches your real work.

hotspots.label: Glowing outline
hotspots.text: Tap the outlined spot to complete the mission. A green note confirms it.

steps.title: Open the practice
steps.text: Tap **Start practice** in the welcome flow, or **Replay the platform tour** in More.

steps.title: Read the mission
steps.text: The dark card says what to do, with a hint. The bars show how many missions you’ve done.

steps.title: Tap the glowing outline
steps.text: Tap the spot outlined in amber. A green note confirms the mission and the next one starts.

steps.title: Finish all nine
steps.text: When you’re done, Platform basics is marked complete in your training.

steps.title: Go back
steps.text: Tap **Back to setup**, **Go to home** or **Practice again**. **Exit** leaves at any time.

tips: Exploring ahead still counts: missions you finish early are ticked off.
On a computer, the full mission list sits next to the sandbox.
The practice is also the **Platform basics (interactive)** module in Training.

sections.title: Your Home screen
sections.summary: Home shows what to do next: your next module, your training progress, your first-week checklist, tasks due soon and the latest news.

shots.caption: A trainee’s Home screen
shots.alt: Home on a phone for a trainee: a purple Next up card for Communication and chat basics with a Continue button, a Training progress card at 33 percent with what’s coming up, and the Getting started checklist.

hotspots.label: Profile
hotspots.text: Your details, documents and sign-in history.

hotspots.label: Next up
hotspots.text: Your next module, its due date and how far you got. Tap **Continue** or **Start**.

hotspots.label: Training progress
hotspots.text: How much assigned training is done, what’s waiting for review and what’s coming up.

hotspots.label: Getting started
hotspots.text: Your first-week checklist. Tap an open item to do it right away.

hotspots.label: Menu
hotspots.text: Switch pages here. **More** holds everything else.

steps.title: Start your next module
steps.text: Tap **Start** or **Continue** on the Next up card. If it says **Fix and resend**, read your mentor’s feedback first.

steps.title: Check your progress
steps.text: Training progress shows how much is done and what’s coming up. Tap **See all** for the full list.

steps.title: Work through Getting started
steps.text: Tap an open item on your first-week checklist to fill out a document or open the practice.

steps.title: See what’s due
steps.text: Due soon lists your next tasks. Tap one, or **All tasks**, to open your board.

steps.title: Read announcements
steps.text: Tap **Mark as read** on posts marked **Please read**. **All news** opens every post.

tips: Getting started shows while you’re a trainee and something on it is still open.
Mentors and leads also see what’s waiting for their review. Admins get an Admin card with access requests, invites and drafts.
Guests see the training, documents and resources shared with them instead.

sections.title: Training
sections.summary: Your assigned modules in the order to do them, plus continued training and an optional library. Modules open one step at a time.

shots.caption: Your training list
shots.alt: The Training page on a phone: an Assigned training summary at 33 percent with a Continue next button, filter pills, and module cards with status, minutes, due date and progress.

hotspots.label: Assigned training
hotspots.text: Everything required for you, as one percentage.

hotspots.label: Continue next
hotspots.text: Jumps straight into the module you should do next.

hotspots.label: Filters
hotspots.text: Show all modules, or only to do, in progress or completed.

hotspots.label: Certificate
hotspots.text: On completed modules when certificates are on. Print it or save it as a PDF.

hotspots.label: Module card
hotspots.text: Tap a card to open it. The chip shows its status, the bar how far you got.

shots.caption: A quiz step in the module player
shots.alt: The module player on a phone at step 2 of 2 of Security and data handling: two quiz questions answered correctly with explanations, a green You scored 100 percent result, and the Finish module button.

hotspots.label: Where you are
hotspots.text: Module name, step number and a progress bar.

hotspots.label: Close
hotspots.text: Leave and come back later. Your place is saved.

hotspots.label: Questions
hotspots.text: Pick one answer per question, then tap **Check answers**.

hotspots.label: Feedback
hotspots.text: Each answer shows whether it’s right, and why.

hotspots.label: Your score
hotspots.text: You need the passing score to continue. **Try again** clears your answers.

hotspots.label: Finish module
hotspots.text: Completes the module, or sends it to your mentor when it needs review.

steps.title: Pick up where you left off
steps.text: Tap **Continue next** at the top to open the module you should do next.

steps.title: Filter the list
steps.text: Tap **To do**, **In progress** or **Completed** to narrow it down, or **All** to see everything.

steps.title: Open a module
steps.text: Tap a card. The overview lists what you’ll learn and how many steps there are. Tap **Start** or **Continue**.

steps.title: Move through the steps
steps.text: Read each slide or page, then tap **Next**. On a computer, the arrow keys work too.

steps.title: Pass the quiz
steps.text: Pick your answers and tap **Check answers**. Below the passing score, tap **Try again**.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Tap **Finish module**, or **Send for review** when your mentor checks it. Then tap **Next module**.

steps.title: Get a certificate
steps.text: On a completed module, tap **Certificate**, then **Print**. Choose “Save as PDF” to keep a copy.

tips: Your place is saved as you go. Quiz answers and assignment drafts stay on the device you used.
**Waiting for review** means your mentor is checking it. **Needs changes** means it came back: open it and tap **Make changes**.
**Certificate** only appears when an owner has switched certificates on.

sections.title: Filling out and signing documents
sections.summary: Forms, uploads, e-signatures and checklists from HR. Sensitive answers are encrypted, and each submission records the time, IP address and device.

shots.caption: Filling out and signing a document
shots.alt: The Payroll and direct deposit form open on a phone: bank name, account type, encrypted routing and account number fields shown as dots, an attached W-4 file, and a typed signature preview, with Sign and submit at the bottom.

hotspots.label: The document
hotspots.text: Its name, type and what it’s for.

hotspots.label: Sensitive answers
hotspots.text: The lock means it’s encrypted. Tap the eye to check what you typed.

hotspots.label: Files
hotspots.text: Attach a PDF or a photo, up to 25 MB. Sensitive files only HR can open.

hotspots.label: Signature
hotspots.text: Type your full legal name. It counts as your electronic signature.

hotspots.label: Sign and submit
hotspots.text: The counter says what’s still required. RAMP records the time, IP address and device.

steps.title: Open a document
steps.text: Tap **Fill out**, **Upload**, **Review and sign** or **Open checklist** in the welcome flow, on Home, on Tasks or in your profile.

steps.title: Answer each field
steps.text: Fields with a red star are required. The bottom of the form counts how many are left.

steps.title: Enter sensitive details
steps.text: Fields with a lock are encrypted. Tap the eye to check what you typed.

steps.title: Attach files
steps.text: Tap **Choose a file or take a photo**. PDFs, images and documents up to 25 MB work.

steps.title: Sign
steps.text: Type your full legal name in the signature field. The preview shows your signature with today’s date.

steps.title: Submit
steps.text: Tap **Sign and submit**, **Submit** or **Upload**. A message confirms it, and the document shows as done.

tips: Need to change something you sent, like your bank? In your profile, under **My documents**, tap **Submit again**.
Only you and HR admins can see sensitive answers and files, and every view is logged.
If HR updates a document you signed, it shows **New version** so you can sign the latest one.

sections.title: Tasks
sections.summary: A board for everything you need to get done. Move each task from To do to Done as you work on it.

shots.caption: Your task board
shots.alt: The Tasks board on a computer with four columns: To do, In progress, In review and Done. Cards show due dates, who assigned them, Form chips with a Fill out button, and buttons to move them along.

hotspots.label: New task
hotspots.text: Add your own task with notes and a due date.

hotspots.label: In review
hotspots.text: Finished on your side and waiting for a check.

hotspots.label: Status columns
hotspots.text: Tasks move left to right. Drag a card to another column, or use its buttons.

hotspots.label: Move a task
hotspots.text: **Start**, **Send for review** and **Mark done** move it one column right; the arrow moves it back.

hotspots.label: Form tasks
hotspots.text: First-week documents. **Fill out** opens the form; sending it marks the task done.

hotspots.label: Assigned to you
hotspots.text: Tasks from your mentor or lead say who they’re from.

steps.title: Add a task
steps.text: Click **New task**, say what needs doing, add notes and a due date, then click **Add task**.

steps.title: Start it
steps.text: Click **Start** to move it to In progress. You can also drag a card to another column.

steps.title: Send it for review
steps.text: When your part is done, click **Send for review**. It moves to In review for a check.

steps.title: Finish it
steps.text: Click **Mark done**. The arrow on the left of a card moves it back a column.

steps.title: Complete form tasks
steps.text: Tasks marked **Form** come from first-week documents. Click **Fill out**; sending the form marks the task done.

steps.title: Edit or delete
steps.text: Click a task’s title to change it, or click **Delete** in the task.

tips: On a phone, tasks are grouped into tabs by status. Change a task’s status with its **Status** menu.
Tasks from your mentor or lead say **From** and their name.
Red due dates are overdue; amber ones are due today.

sections.title: Your notebook
sections.summary: Private pages for module notes, meeting notes and files. Share a page with your mentor and lead when you want feedback.

shots.caption: A notebook page
shots.alt: The Notebook on a computer: a list of pages on the left with Shared chips and a Vault link, and the open page Module notes: How we use tasks, with its text, an attached file, the Share with my mentor and lead switch and the Training module link.

hotspots.label: New page
hotspots.text: Start blank or from a template: meeting notes, daily log or questions for your mentor.

hotspots.label: Your pages
hotspots.text: Search, open a page or a sub-page. **Shared** marks pages your mentor can read.

hotspots.label: Write
hotspots.text: Type a title and notes. Everything saves as you go; look for **Saved**.

hotspots.label: Vault
hotspots.text: Your encrypted saved logins.

hotspots.label: Attachments
hotspots.text: Add screenshots, PDFs or other files, up to 25 MB each.

hotspots.label: Share and link
hotspots.text: Let your mentor and lead read this page, and link it to a training module.

steps.title: Create a page
steps.text: Click **New page**, choose where it goes, then pick **Blank page**, **Meeting notes**, **Daily log** or **Questions for my mentor**.

steps.title: Write
steps.text: Type a title and your notes. Everything saves as you type; look for **Saved** at the top.

steps.title: Attach files
steps.text: Click **Attach a file** to add screenshots or PDFs, up to 25 MB each.

steps.title: Share it
steps.text: Turn on **Share with my mentor and lead**. They can read the page but not change it.

steps.title: Organize
steps.text: Link the page to a **Training module**, move it **Inside** another page, or click **Add a sub-page**.

steps.title: Find a page
steps.text: Type in **Search pages** to search titles and text.

tips: Pages are private until you share them. Shared pages show a **Shared** chip.
On a phone you see the list first. Tap a page to open it, and **All pages** to go back.
**Delete page** also deletes its sub-pages and attached files.

sections.title: Your Vault
sections.summary: Encrypted storage for your work logins. Only you can open it: not your mentor, your lead or admins.

shots.caption: Your Vault
shots.alt: The Vault on a phone with four saved logins. The Dispatch board login shows its password with a Hides in 30s countdown, and Copy password and Hide buttons.

hotspots.label: Add a login
hotspots.text: Save a name, username, link and password. RAMP can generate a strong one.

hotspots.label: Only you
hotspots.text: Entries are encrypted. Your mentor, lead and admins can’t open them.

hotspots.label: Password shown
hotspots.text: Shown for 30 seconds, then hidden again.

hotspots.label: Copy
hotspots.text: Copy the password or username without showing it to anyone nearby.

hotspots.label: Edit
hotspots.text: Change the details or password, or delete the login.

steps.title: Add a login
steps.text: Tap **Add a login**, fill in **Name**, **Username or email**, **Website** and the password, then tap **Save login**.

steps.title: Generate a password
steps.text: Tap **Generate** for a strong 20-character password. It’s copied, so you can paste it into the other site.

steps.title: Show a password
steps.text: Tap **Show password**. It hides again after 30 seconds, or when you tap **Hide**.

steps.title: Copy without showing
steps.text: Tap **Copy password** or **Copy username** to paste it without anyone seeing it.

steps.title: Edit or delete
steps.text: Tap the pencil to change the details or password, or **Delete** to remove the login.

tips: Find the Vault under **More** on a phone, or at the bottom of your notebook’s page list on a computer.
Once you have more than five logins, a search box appears.

sections.title: Chat
sections.summary: Company, department and cohort channels, plus direct messages with anyone on the team.

shots.caption: Chat with your mentor
shots.alt: Chat on a computer: channels and direct messages on the left with unread dots, and a direct message conversation with Sam Patel on the right, with the message box at the bottom.

hotspots.label: New message
hotspots.text: Pick anyone on the team to message directly.

hotspots.label: Channels
hotspots.text: Company, department and cohort channels. The lock means only admins post.

hotspots.label: Conversation
hotspots.text: Messages are grouped by day. Your own are on the right.

hotspots.label: Unread
hotspots.text: An amber dot means new messages since you last looked.

hotspots.label: Direct messages
hotspots.text: One-to-one conversations, newest first.

hotspots.label: Write a message
hotspots.text: Enter sends; Shift+Enter starts a new line.

steps.title: Open a conversation
steps.text: Pick a channel or a person on the left. On a phone, tap one, then the back arrow to return to the list.

steps.title: Send a message
steps.text: Type in the box at the bottom and press Enter. Shift+Enter starts a new line.

steps.title: Message someone new
steps.text: Click **New message**, search by name, role or department, and pick the person.

steps.title: Spot new messages
steps.text: An amber dot next to a channel or person means messages you haven’t seen.

steps.title: Delete a message
steps.text: Hover over your message, or tap it on a phone, then tap the trash icon.

tips: **announcements** is read-only: only admins post there.
Keep updates about a piece of work on its task, and use chat for conversation.
If an owner switches Chat off, it leaves the menu. Past messages are kept.

sections.title: Resources
sections.summary: Policies, SOPs, guides and tools for your work, all in one place.

shots.caption: Resources
shots.alt: Resources on a phone: a search box, category filters, and lists of policies, SOPs and guides with Required and Your role chips.

hotspots.label: Search
hotspots.text: Find a policy, SOP or guide by title or text.

hotspots.label: Categories
hotspots.text: Show one kind of resource at a time.

hotspots.label: Required
hotspots.text: Required reading for you. Open it before your due dates.

hotspots.label: Your role
hotspots.text: Resources for your job role.

hotspots.label: Opens in RAMP
hotspots.text: Some resources open a RAMP page, like this guide.

steps.title: Search
steps.text: Type in the search box to find a resource by its title or text.

steps.title: Filter by category
steps.text: Tap **Policies**, **SOPs**, **Guides**, **Tools** or **Other**. **All** shows everything.

steps.title: Open a resource
steps.text: Tap it. Text opens right here, web links open in a new tab, and **Opens in RAMP** goes to a RAMP page.

steps.title: Close it
steps.text: Use **Open link** or **Open file** if the resource has one, then tap **Done**.

tips: **Required** marks reading you’re expected to do. **Your role** marks resources for your job.
Guests only see the resources shared with guests.

sections.title: News
sections.summary: Announcements from the company and your department. Some ask you to confirm you’ve read them.

shots.caption: News
shots.alt: News on a phone: a reminder that one post needs confirming, an Office closed for Thanksgiving post highlighted with Please confirm and a Mark as read button, and older posts including a department post for Operations.

hotspots.label: Needs confirming
hotspots.text: How many posts are waiting for you to confirm you’ve read them.

hotspots.label: Please confirm
hotspots.text: Highlighted until you confirm.

hotspots.label: Mark as read
hotspots.text: Confirms you’ve read it. Admins can see who hasn’t yet.

hotspots.label: Department news
hotspots.text: Posts from your department lead show your department’s name.

steps.title: Read new posts
steps.text: Open **News** from the menu, or from **More** on a phone. The newest posts are at the top.

steps.title: Confirm you’ve read it
steps.text: Posts marked **Please confirm** are highlighted. Read it, then tap **Mark as read**.

steps.title: See who it’s for
steps.text: Department posts show the department’s name. Everything else is company news.

steps.title: Post to your department (leads)
steps.text: Department leads tap **Post to my department**, add a **Headline** and **Message**, and post it.

tips: The amber number on News counts posts you still need to confirm.
Leads can tick **Ask everyone to confirm they’ve read it** when they post.
Admins post and track read receipts in **Admin › Announcements**.

sections.title: Your profile
sections.summary: Your details, your account, every document you’ve completed, your recent sign-ins and your password.

shots.caption: Your documents and sign-in history
shots.alt: The Profile page on a phone scrolled to My documents, listing completed onboarding documents with View and Submit again buttons and two first-week checklists, followed by Sign-in history with dates, devices and IP addresses.

hotspots.label: My documents
hotspots.text: Every form, upload and agreement that applies to you, with what’s still to do.

hotspots.label: View
hotspots.text: Opens what you sent, with the date, IP address and device recorded.

hotspots.label: Submit again
hotspots.text: Send an updated version, for example after you change banks.

hotspots.label: To do
hotspots.text: Documents you still need to complete.

hotspots.label: Sign-in history
hotspots.text: Your last 10 sign-ins. Don’t recognize one? Change your password and tell an admin.

steps.title: Update your details
steps.text: Change your **Full name**, **Preferred name**, **Mobile phone** or **Time zone**, then tap **Save details**.

steps.title: Check your account
steps.text: **Your account** shows your email, access level, role, department, mentor and start date. Ask an admin to change them.

steps.title: Review your documents
steps.text: Under **My documents**, tap **View** to see a record, or **Submit again** to send an update.

steps.title: Check your sign-ins
steps.text: **Sign-in history** lists your last 10 sign-ins with the device and IP address.

steps.title: Change your password
steps.text: Type a **New password** and **Confirm new password**, then tap **Change password**.

tips: Don’t recognize a sign-in? Change your password right away and tell an admin.
Leave **Time zone** on the company time zone unless you work somewhere else.

sections.title: My team
sections.summary: Mentors see their trainees, department leads see their department and admins see everyone, with work waiting for review at the top.

shots.caption: My team, for a mentor
shots.alt: My team on a computer for a mentor: two items waiting for review with Review buttons, then the list of trainees with their stage, items to review and training progress bars.

hotspots.label: Waiting for your review
hotspots.text: Work your trainees sent. Oldest first.

hotspots.label: Review
hotspots.text: Opens the answer and score so you can approve or return it.

hotspots.label: Search
hotspots.text: Find someone by name, email or role.

hotspots.label: Stage and progress
hotspots.text: Onboarding, Training x% or Graduated, plus anything to review or overdue.

hotspots.label: Open a person
hotspots.text: Their plan, shared notebook pages and tasks.

steps.title: Open your team
steps.text: Click **My team** in the menu (**Team progress** for admins). The badge counts work waiting for you.

steps.title: Review waiting work

hotspots.label: Graduate
hotspots.text: Moves a trainee to their role’s access level.

hotspots.label: Tabs
hotspots.text: Overview, Training, Documents, Files, Sign-ins and Activity.

hotspots.label: Summary
hotspots.text: How many sign-ins, from how many IP addresses and devices.

hotspots.label: A sign-in
hotspots.text: Date and time in the company time zone, IP address and device.

hotspots.label: New IP or device
hotspots.text: Flagged the first time each one appears. Check anything unexpected.

steps.title: Open a record
steps.text: In **People**, click a person. The chips under their name show their level, status and stage.

steps.title: Change their access
steps.text: On **Overview**, click **Change** next to access level, job role, department, mentor or start date.

steps.title: Review their training
steps.text: On **Training**, click **Approve** or **Return with feedback** on work waiting for review.

steps.title: Open a signed record
steps.text: On **Documents**, click **View record** for their answers, signature, date and time, IP address, device and version.

steps.title: Reveal sensitive data
steps.text: Click **Reveal** for an encrypted answer, or **Open** for a file. Each one is written to the audit log.

steps.title: Check sign-ins and activity
steps.text: **Sign-ins** flags new IP addresses and devices. **Activity** lists everything done by or about them.

steps.title: Graduate, pause or remove
steps.text: **Graduate** moves a trainee to their role’s access. **Pause access** keeps their records; **Remove person** deletes them.

tips: Opening someone’s record is itself recorded in the audit log.
When someone leaves, pause their access instead of removing them, so you keep their records.
The **Files** tab lists every file they’ve uploaded.

settings.name: Access level
settings.effect: What they can see and do. Only an owner can make or change an owner.

settings.name: Job role
settings.effect: Changes their role training right away, and their department to match the role.

settings.name: Department
settings.effect: Which department lead sees them, and which department news they get.

settings.name: Mentor
settings.effect: Who reviews their work and can read the pages they share.

settings.name: Start date
settings.effect: Training due dates count from this date.

settings.name: Guest access until
settings.effect: Guests only. After this date they can’t sign in until you extend it.

settings.name: Pause access
settings.effect: Stops them signing in and keeps their records. **Restore access** turns it back on.

sections.title: Metrics
sections.summary: Onboarding and training progress across the team, updated each time you open the page.

shots.caption: Metrics
shots.alt: The Metrics page: a department filter, six key numbers, and the onboarding funnel from invited to graduated.

hotspots.label: Export people progress
hotspots.text: Downloads a spreadsheet of everyone’s progress.

hotspots.label: Department
hotspots.text: See everyone, or one department.

hotspots.label: Key numbers
hotspots.text: Members, onboarding, days to onboard, required training, overdue items and reviews.

hotspots.label: Onboarding funnel
hotspots.text: How far everyone who started as a trainee has got.

steps.title: Pick a department
steps.text: Use **Department** to see everyone or one department.

steps.title: Read the key numbers
steps.text: Active members, people in onboarding, median days to onboard, required training done, overdue items and reviews.

steps.title: Follow the funnel
steps.text: **Onboarding funnel** shows how many trainees were invited, joined, onboarded and graduated.

steps.title: Check modules and documents
steps.text: Scroll down for each module’s completion and average score, and progress on each onboarding document.

steps.title: Export
steps.text: Click **Export people progress** for a spreadsheet of everyone in view.

tips: A module’s completion counts only the people it’s assigned to.
Hover over or focus a funnel bar for the exact numbers.

sections.title: Announcements
sections.summary: Post news to everyone or one group, and see who has read it.

shots.caption: Announcements
shots.alt: The Announcements admin page with the first post expanded: its audience and Read confirmation chips, a 4 of 9 read progress bar, the message, the people who haven’t read it yet and a Delete announcement button.

hotspots.label: Post an announcement
hotspots.text: Title, message, audience and whether to ask for read confirmation.

hotspots.label: Audience
hotspots.text: Everyone, trainees, employees or one department.

hotspots.label: Read so far
hotspots.text: How many of the audience confirmed they’ve read it.

hotspots.label: Hasn’t read it yet
hotspots.text: Who still needs to confirm, so you can follow up.

hotspots.label: Delete
hotspots.text: Removes it for everyone.

steps.title: Write a post
steps.text: Click **Post an announcement**, add a **Title** and **Message**, and choose the **Audience**.

steps.title: Ask for confirmation
steps.text: Tick **Ask people to confirm they’ve read it** to collect read receipts.

steps.title: Post it
steps.text: Click the **Post to** button. It shows how many people will see it.

steps.title: Track who has read it
steps.text: Each post shows how many have read it. Open it to see who hasn’t yet.

steps.title: Delete a post
steps.text: Open the post and click **Delete announcement** to remove it for everyone.

tips: Read receipts are only collected when you ask people to confirm.
Department leads can post to their own department from News.

settings.name: Audience: Everyone
settings.effect: Every active team member. Guests don’t see news.

settings.name: Audience: Trainees
settings.effect: Only people still in training.

settings.name: Audience: Employees
settings.effect: Employees and everyone above them: mentors, leads, admins and owners.

settings.name: Audience: A department
settings.effect: Everyone in the department you pick.

settings.name: Ask people to confirm they’ve read it
settings.effect: Highlights the post in their News until they tap **Mark as read**, and shows you who hasn’t.

sections.title: Managing resources
sections.summary: Add the policies, SOPs, guides and tools people find in Resources, as a link, a file or a page of text.

shots.caption: Managing resources
shots.alt: The Resources admin page: category filters and the list of resources with up and down arrows, category, Required, audience and Guests chips.

hotspots.label: Add a resource
hotspots.text: A link, a file or a page of text.

hotspots.label: Category
hotspots.text: Filter the list by category.

hotspots.label: Order
hotspots.text: The arrows set the order people see.

hotspots.label: Who it’s for
hotspots.text: Everyone or one role, Required, and whether guests can see it.

steps.title: Add a resource
steps.text: Click **Add a resource**, enter a **Title** and pick a **Category**.

steps.title: Add the content
steps.text: Paste a **Link**, click **Choose a file**, or write **Text**. A link starting with / opens a RAMP page, like /guide.

steps.title: Choose who sees it
steps.text: Under **Who it’s for**, pick everyone or one role. Tick **Required reading** or **Guests can see it** if needed.

steps.title: Save
steps.text: Click **Add resource**, or **Save changes** when you’re editing.

steps.title: Set the order
steps.text: Use the up and down arrows. People see resources in this order.

steps.title: Edit or delete
steps.text: Click the pencil to edit. In the editor, **Delete resource** removes it.

tips: Filter the list by category with the chips at the top.
Files are stored privately and open through short-lived links.

settings.name: Category
settings.effect: Policy, SOP, Guide, Tool or Other. Groups it on the Resources page.

settings.name: Link
settings.effect: A web page or tool, or a RAMP page starting with /.

settings.name: File
settings.effect: A file up to 25 MB, stored privately.

settings.name: Text
settings.effect: Shown on the resource itself, like a short SOP or a note on what the link is for.

settings.name: Who it’s for
settings.effect: Everyone, or one job role.

settings.name: Required reading
settings.effect: Marked **Required** for the people it’s for.

settings.name: Guests can see it
settings.effect: Contractors and candidates with guest access can see it.

sections.title: System and audit
sections.summary: Feature switches, how RAMP protects your records, and the full audit log of who did what.

shots.caption: Feature switches
shots.alt: System and audit, signed in as an owner: the Feature switches card with Chat, Tasks, Certificates and Record IP address and device, each with an on or off switch, and the Save switches button.

hotspots.label: Chat and Tasks
hotspots.text: Turn whole tools on or off for everyone. Nothing is deleted.

hotspots.label: Certificates
hotspots.text: Certificates for completed modules.

hotspots.label: Record IP address and device
hotspots.text: Saved with every sign-in, signature and submission.

hotspots.label: Save switches
hotspots.text: Owners only. Admins see the switches but can’t change them.

hotspots.label: How RAMP protects records
hotspots.text: Encryption, logging, private files and row-level security.

shots.caption: The audit log
shots.alt: The audit log: search and person filters, an Export button, and a table of entries with time, who, action, person, detail, IP address and device. Revealed and Opened file entries are highlighted.

hotspots.label: Export
hotspots.text: Downloads the entries shown as a spreadsheet.

hotspots.label: Search
hotspots.text: Find actions and details by word.

hotspots.label: Person
hotspots.text: Everything done by or about one person.

hotspots.label: IP and device
hotspots.text: Where each action came from. On narrower screens, scroll the table sideways to see the device.

hotspots.label: Sensitive actions
hotspots.text: Reveals and file opens are highlighted.

steps.title: Change a feature (owners)
steps.text: Flip a switch, then click **Save switches**. **Undo changes** puts them back.

steps.title: See how records are protected
steps.text: **How RAMP protects your records** explains encryption, logging, private files and row-level security.

steps.title: Search the audit log
steps.text: Type in **Search actions and details**, or pick a person, to filter the log.

steps.title: Spot sensitive actions
steps.text: Reveals and file opens are highlighted. Each entry shows who, when, the IP address and device.

steps.title: See older entries
steps.text: The newest 50 show first. Click **Load 50 more** for older ones.

steps.title: Export
steps.text: Click **Export** to download the entries shown as a spreadsheet.

tips: Only owners can change feature switches. Admins can see them.
Turning a feature off never deletes anything.
On narrower screens, scroll the audit table sideways to see the device.

settings.name: Chat
settings.effect: Channels and direct messages. Off: Chat leaves the menu and nobody can post. Past messages are kept.

settings.name: Tasks
settings.effect: The task board, and assigning tasks. Off: Tasks leaves the menu. Existing tasks are kept.

settings.name: Certificates
settings.effect: A certificate on each completed module. Off: no certificates are shown.

settings.name: Record IP address and device
settings.effect: Saved with every sign-in, signature and submission. Off: new records don’t include them; existing records keep theirs.
